RoughExactInterpolation assembles the full exact interpolation lemma. One eventual threshold precedes every t,m,theta and every index. It constructs a rational quotient of degree<=q-e, with w-smooth coefficient denominators, integral values at all original indices and error<=Cq*A*Z^(-e). D is chosen before all integer data and Cq depends only on q.

RoughExactInterpolationModOne proves the standard UnitAddCircle norm equals the integer-distance infimum and the near-integer existential, then obtains the full theorem from the original mod-one hypothesis.

RoughInterpolationPaperGrowth derives power domination and eventual positivity from S tending to infinity and positive-natural-power ratio divergence. The final theorem accepts precisely all positive real exponent ratio divergences Z/S^a tending to infinity, and any roughness sequence tending to infinity.

The eventual threshold is outside all t,m,theta quantifiers and includes both rational lattice thresholds and roughness>=D. H is fixed first. There is no bounded-coefficient assumption, no bound m<=w, and no input asserting interpolation or exact division.
